messages.author: Fuka
messages.text:
***To get access to the server you must have your YouTube or Twitch linked to your Discord!! If you don't know how to do that below is a tutorial on how to.  ***

**How to Connect your YouTube Channel to Discord**
1. Open up the Discord app and next to your username to access the cog wheel. 
2. Under your User Settings, head to the Connections tab.
3. Connect your YouTube/Twitch account to your Discord account by pressing on the YouTube tile.  This will open a new browser window where you can log into your YouTube account. 
4. After logging into your YouTube account you should get a message stating you’ve successfully connected your accounts.

***FOR CONTENT CREATORS AND YOUTUBERS  ***
If you want to apply for the Youtubers and Content Creators role please message one of the @Admins or @Moderators . We don't give this role to anyone only people that have a decent following.

***Server Boosters Get Access to the Discord as well ***
Boosting the server is a great way to help and also get access to the discord.
